goal: A DONE run's branch that fails rebase onto the advanced base still lands unattended through a merge-fallback rung re-verified at rebase parity, or parks with its branch and worktree preserved under a queryable park kind and the landing rung recorded on the run's ledger.

graders.name: lint
graders.run: uv run ruff check packages/flywheel-core packages/flywheel-worktree packages/flywheel-orchestrator

relevant: packages/flywheel-worktree/src/flywheel_worktree/worker.py -- GitWorktreeSubmitter._submit (the rebase-conflict leaf at the divergent-base park), _reverify, _standing_verify, _record_landing, _record_landing_park, _rebase_parked_branch and its prepare_sandbox caller, build_merge_submitter, build_held_out_source; module is over 800 lines, use serena symbols
packages/flywheel-core/src/flywheel_core/events.py -- LANDING_PARK_KINDS and the Landed record; the vocabulary and the landing-rung discriminator live here
packages/flywheel-core/src/flywheel_core/event_serde.py -- serde for the changed Landed shape, updated in this same change
packages/flywheel-orchestrator/src/flywheel_orchestrator/_claims.py -- record_human_review validates queue reasons against LANDING_PARK_KINDS (~line 241); any new park kind must be accepted here

packages/flywheel-orchestrator/src/flywheel_orchestrator/_orchestrate.py -- redrive_parked_landings and _reevaluate_landing_gate (the re-driver that will exercise the new rung); module is over 800 lines, use serena symbols
packages/flywheel-orchestrator/src/flywheel_orchestrator/_held_out_gate.py -- evaluate_held_out_gate takes committed_tree; read-only reference for running the gate against the merged candidate tree
packages/flywheel-worktree/tests/test_landing_record.py -- keep green; also the real-git harness + recording-ledger pattern to mirror
packages/flywheel-orchestrator/tests/test_redriver_queue.py -- keep green; the criterion-7 bound and exactly-once queueing live here
references: .flywheel/proposals/overnight-2026-07-08.md -- P4: the manual recovery recipe this rung mechanizes (detached-worktree merge, full verify ladder, compare-and-swap ref update)
docs/strategy.md -- the landing decision tree the new rung extends; every leaf is a land or a park-with-reason
constraints: Nothing lands unverified: before the base ref moves, the merged candidate tree must re-pass the task's command graders, [submit] verify, and the declared held-out gate; any failure leaves the base ref byte-identical and appends no Landed record (D-2, criteria 1-2)

Every recovery failure for a DONE run preserves the branch ref and its parked worktree; the prepare_sandbox reuse path's discard-on-failed-rebase must become DONE-aware -- discard stays only for non-DONE retry reuse (D-3, criterion 3)

Any new park kind is added to LANDING_PARK_KINDS and accepted by _claims.record_human_review reason validation in this same change; it must be queryable via list_domain_events and visible in flywheel status stranded output

The Landed record gains a landing-rung discriminator covering at least rebase and merge-fallback lands (agent-resolved arrives in a later task); update event_serde round-trip and every Landed producer -- give the field a default that keeps pr.py records valid or update pr.py in the same change

Merge-fallback failures append fresh LandingParked witnesses so they count toward the existing landing_redrive_bound; the bound, witness pairing, and exactly-once human-review queueing of spec 00069 are unchanged (criterion 7)
All base mutations stay under the merge lock; submit still MUST NOT raise
Commit the change (Conventional Commits) before reporting done
non_goals: Do not weaken, delete, or modify existing assertions in the pinned test files
No agentic conflict resolution -- when the merge-fallback rung itself conflicts, this task parks (a later task escalates)
Do not change held-out gate internals (_held_out_gate.py evaluation engine, registration format)
Do not change the PR strategy's landing or park semantics
Do not read or write under .flywheel/verification/
edge_cases: Criterion 1: after a merge-fallback land, git merge-base --is-ancestor <original-branch-head> <base> exits 0 and the base ref advanced; a ledger 'landed' with no ancestor relation must fail the behavior test
Criterion 2 mutation: a grader that passes on the branch alone but fails on the merged tree must park with the base ref byte-identical before and after the pass
Receipts on the new rung's parks/lands must come from checks run against the candidate tree, never recycled from the original attempt
Criterion 3: on a merge conflict the rung aborts cleanly -- branch ref still resolves, worktree directory exists with no in-progress merge state, park kind queryable on ledger and in status
Criterion 7: a permanently failing re-verify stops at the existing redrive bound with the park record and preserved branch intact
Must-not-regress: clean-FF still runs [submit] verify (spec 00064); base checked-out (in-tree) and separate-base (out-of-tree) layouts both land correctly
